description:
Delete the help center you created, with everything in it, and revoke its agent key. Irreversible.

Only when the user asks for it, or when you created it by mistake (a wrong name or language). There is no need to clean up after handing over the claim link: an unclaimed help center is deleted by itself 7 days after creation. A help center the user has claimed is theirs: this answers already_claimed and deletes nothing.

Returns { status: "success" | "pending", site_id }. "pending" means the deletion is finishing in the background; nothing more is needed.

Args:
  - site_id (number, required): as helpcenter_create_help_center returned it.

agent_key.description: The api_key helpcenter_create_help_center returned for this help center, exactly as returned. Required on every call: this endpoint has no sign-in, so the key is how each call says which help center it acts on. It is sent to HelpCenter.io as this call's credential and nowhere else, and it is never shown again: keep it for the whole task, and never show it to the user or write it into content.

site_id.description: The site_id helpcenter_create_help_center returned for this help center.

name: helpcenter_discard_help_center
title: Delete an Unclaimed Help Center
